text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list:
Amazing, your cornering today is 
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's probably because the world has looked 
tilted to me today. Ever since I woke up 
this morning.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If the world is tilted, cornering is 
practically running in a straight line. 
And if it's a straight line, you can run 
at top speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The slight drawback is that the straight 
line looks a bit slanted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That is a problem in itself. Fatigue 
from recent races might still be 
lingering. Let's review the schedule."
